newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian overnight rates widen, one-week steady.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian overnight rates widen, one-week steady.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened slightly on Tuesday in a moderately liquid private sector market while one-week rates remained steady, bankers said.
Overnight rates ranged between 10 and 10-1/4 percent compared to Monday's range of 10 and 10-1/8 percent.
One-week rates were unchanged at between 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent.
Public-sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent.
